reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding — nothing is being raised with the counterparty.

The cited text supports compliance on its readable material terms: Section 11.2 obliges the counterparty (Harpoon) to defend, indemnify and hold harmless AbbVie, its Affiliates and their personnel against Third Party Claims, so the indemnity is not one-way and is not walk-away territory.

IP scope is reasonably inferred from Section 7.4, which subordinates AbbVie's defence right to Section 11.2 and expressly contemplates Harpoon's liability 'to indemnify any AbbVie Indemnitee' for Third Party patent infringement claims; Sections 11.3–11.4.1 supply the standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics the rule expects.

The failed deterministic check ('vendor indemnity for IP infringement present') is explained by the redacted trigger lists ([***]) in both 11.1 and 11.2 — a regex cannot match text that has been withheld — and the rationale transparently flags that the unredacted execution copy should be confirmed rather than overstating coverage.

Noted-but-not-flagged items (absence of an indemnity super-cap, which favours us, and the redacted breadth of our reciprocal 11.1 indemnity) are correctly treated as rationale notes rather than deviations, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics.
